title: Returned-Payment Cut in the Number of Settlement Installments, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Rule.** Two or more returned payments of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts (bank returns of posted deficiency payments, as the account ledger records them) dated fewer than 12 whole months before today cut 2 installments from an installment settlement, exactly one cuts 1 installment, and none cuts nothing. Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's.

| Returned payments dated fewer than 12 whole months before today | Installments cut |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 2 |
| Exactly one | 1 |
| None | None |

Each return counts once, by its own date, and only returns on this account count. Hypothetically, with today the 25th of a month, a return dated the 26th of the same month a year earlier counts, and one dated the 25th of that month a year earlier does not.
